messages:
deploy-bot: Auto-rollback: embeddings rollout v3.7.1 triggered at 2024-11-03T14:07:34Z — p95 error-rate for embeddings-service > 4% (threshold 0.5%). Initiating targeted canary revert.

alice: saw the alert. holding 90s before action. could be kv-cache format change from last commit? anyone near the kvcache PR?

devin: that was my PR. it adjusted the preprocessor tokenization. QA noted a subtle drift on small batch. recommend targeted revert of model variant first, not full service.

marco: @deploy-bot clarify: automatic revert scope? which instance groups?
deploy-bot: Auto-rollback scope: revert artifact on instance groups breaching threshold. Targets flagged: embeddings-canary-usw2, embeddings-canary-eu.

alice: manual override: stop global unwind. we'll roll embeddings to 3.7.0 only and pin dedicated pools to 3.7.0 while we triage. No change to reranker or other services.

marco: executing partial revert now:
```
redwoodctl rollout revert --service=embeddings --variant=embedding-v1 --to=3.7.0 --env=canary
```

marco: will also pin dedicated pool:
```
redwoodctl pool pin dedicated-embeddings 3.7.0 --reason "post-deploy error spike Nov 3"
```

ops_oncall: joining bridge. I'll watch traces and slow kill new pods. @support_jen can you prepare a short customer note in case customers are affected?

support_jen: draft: "We're rolling back an embeddings model rollout (started 2024-11-03) due to increased 5xx and timeouts for a subset of requests. Canary reverted; dedicated pools pinned to previous stable version. We'll update if we find customer impact." I'll queue to #support-updates once you approve.

pm_liz: Ops — can you pull list of customers with errors in last 30m? I'll prepare templated comms for dedicated contract holders.

devin: running telemetry query:
```
SELECT customer_id, count(*) AS errs
FROM telemetry.requests
WHERE service='embeddings' AND status>=500 AND ts > now() - interval '30 minutes'
GROUP BY customer_id
ORDER BY errs DESC
LIMIT 50;
```

devin: looks tiny: 6 tenants, mostly internal testbeds. no high-value customer noise yet.

marco: embeddings-canary-usw2 rollback started at 14:11Z: draining inflight, swapping artifact.

deploy-bot: step status: embeddings-canary-usw2 -> SUCCEEDED. embeddings-canary-eu -> FAILED (missing 3.7.0 artifact in eu registry mirror). Logs: https://ci.redwoodinternal/reverts/1725556793

marco: fetching eu artifact mirror, retrying.

deploy-bot: embeddings-canary-eu -> SUCCEEDED at 14:16Z. Both canaries reverted to 3.7.0.

ops_oncall: pin applied to pool dedicated-embeddings. Traffic now routed to pinned 3.7.0 instances. Monitoring p95 and error-rate.

alice: dashboards: canary p95 back to baseline, error rate down to ~0.2%. good.

pm_liz: adding release note: "v3.7.1: embeddings rollout reverted due to increased error rates; embeddings reverted to v3.7.0; investigation ongoing."

support_jen: posted support update and created ticket INC-2024-871 (https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INC-2024-871). Adding logs and samples.

devin: next steps: diff preprocessor + model config between 3.7.0 and 3.7.1; run eval set against 3.7.1 locally. tagging @marco @alice for repro.

alice: please upload failing input examples to INC-2024-871 so ML can reproduce quickly.

marco: added traces, sample inputs, and a small runbook note: prefer variant-level rollback by default; make sure registry mirrors warmed before re-deploys to avoid failed rollbacks.

deploy-bot: Incident summary: canary auto-rollback triggered; manual override to targeted revert; canaries reverted; dedicated pools pinned; ticket created. Awaiting RCA. :white_check_mark:

ops_oncall: handoff to ML and release management for RCA. Bridge open for 1h in case telemetry shows late regressions.
